title: 2025 Reunion - Insurance Panel: Markel International
description:
This year on our Insurance panel at the 2025 Reunion we welcomed the Markel International team to talk about the 25-year journey from the acquisition of Terra Nova to today. The panel explored what it took to turn a "scratch and dent" acquisition into one of the fastest growing and most profitable businesses at Markel Group.

Simon Wilson, CEO of Markel Insurance, moderated the panel of Jo Browning (Senior Managing Director, People), Nick Line (Chief Underwriting Officer), Frederick Wulff (CEO Markel Insurance SE and Managing Director, Europe) and Andrew McMellin, the newly appointed President of Markel International.

Learn more about the Reunion at MKLReunion.com
